However, you then attempt \`git checkout -B {branch_name} origin/{branch_name}\`. This will ALWAYS fail with \`fatal: branch is already checked out\` because Git prevents checking out the same branch twice. Since you now properly return \`None\` on checkout failure, this collision will just repeatedly hit the circuit breaker. 33: 
34: ## Core Concepts
35: 
36: An Antigravity **plugin** is a namespaced, shareable bundle that packages **skills**, **rules**, **hooks**, and optionally **MCP server configs** and **sidecar definitions** into a single deployable unit. Plugins are the recommended way to distribute complex agent behaviours.
37: 
38: A plugin has two distinct concerns:
39: 
40: | Concern | Where it lives | Mutable? | Committed? |
41: |---------|---------------|:--------:|:----------:|
42: | **Plugin code** (scripts, skills, rules, hooks templates) | `.agents/plugins/<name>/` | ❌ Immutable | ✅ Submodule |
